config.notes: Threshold percentiles, profiles, pools and quotas are specified before counting. All candidates come from the existing ALT-30 IDs only. No actions, validation states, test states, models, optimizer or simulator are read/run. Geometry is a descriptive relation, never proof of action compatibility. Dense distance arrays exist in RAM only. Failed slots remain missing and are counted.

pair_count_convention: Symmetric conditions count unordered distinct-frame pairs once; ordered pairs are twice this. Top-k relations and per-anchor candidate degrees are directed.
array_storage_note: Float64 distance computation, float32 RAM matrices; no dense matrix saved.
interpretation_limits: Thresholds are relative training-distribution percentiles, not calibrated physical/action tolerances.
Frame-uniform anchors and pair counts give longer episodes more weight.
Partial batches are reported, never padded into successful batches.
